privileged_info_for_vlm: Sandworm (APT44/Voodoo Bear) is attributed to Russia (GRU); common techniques include Data Destruction (T1485) and Drive-by Compromise (T1189). Lazarus Group (APT38/Hidden Cobra) is attributed to North Korea; common techniques include Spearphishing (T1566) and Data Encrypted for Impact (T1486). The bookmark folder must be exactly 'APT Research'. Sub-folders can be 'Lazarus' or 'Lazarus Group'. The report must be at ~/Desktop/threat_intel_report.txt. Valid research domains include attack.mitre.org, cisa.gov, fbi.gov, and nsa.gov.
